data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006's bounded-depth lookahead counterexample contradicts SRC_010's monotone τ-sweep fixpoint, because any promotion of UNDECIDED nodes that respects the grounded extension must be monotone in the attack graph; therefore the counterexample depends on a non-monotone edge synthesis step. Refuted if there is a monotone bounded-depth lookahead that preserves the no-new-attacker-on-root condition and changes the grounded status of a non-root node.
